How I work

Plan, make, publish, measure.

How I would work with you: four steps, repeated each week. What I learn goes into the next plan.

  1. Plan

    A content calendar built around Waitangi Day and the other dates your visitors plan for.

  2. Make

    Images and short video in Canva and CapCut. I write the English copy. A fluent reader checks any te reo before it is used.

  3. Publish

    Facebook, Instagram and email. I would send posts through a review app, where the team checks them and leaves notes.

  4. Measure

    Opens, saves and shares, looked at each week. I would send you a one‑page report, and what I learn goes back into the plan.

If you hire me

My first 90 days.

Three steps in order. Each ends with one thing you can check.

Days 1 to 30 · Listen and fix
  • Learn the channels, the tone and who signs off.
  • Put expiry dates on the home banner and price tables.
  • Draft the Waitangi Day 2027 countdown before the January programme.

Banner and price tables carry expiry dates.

Days 31 to 60 · Plan and ship
  • Cruise and international set in Chinese and other languages.
  • A 60‑second teacher explainer for the virtual lessons on YouTube.
  • Fill the calendar for the next four weeks.

One cruise set in two languages, sent for review.

Days 61 to 90 · Measure and extend
  • Look at what people opened, saved and shared.
  • Keep what worked. Drop what did not.
  • Plan the next quarter with you.

One‑page weekly report, every week.
